text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-g-r-e-e-d w-i-t-h r-i-v-a-l f-i-r-m-s t-o c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e b-i-d d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-e-t-i-n-g-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g w-r-i-t-t-e-n a-n-d e-m-a-i-l p-r-o-m-i-s-e-s o-f f-u-t-u-r-e j-o-i-n-t-w-o-r-k, w-h-i-l-e f-a-i-l-i-n-g t-o r-u-n t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d l-o-w-b-al-u-m s-h-e-l-l p-r-o-p-o-s-a-l s f-o-r t-h-e t-w-o r-i-v-a-l b-i-d-d-e-r-s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g m-a-c-r-o b-a-s-e-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-i-l-e-s o-n a s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-s-i-t-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-y-v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f e-a-c-h b-i-d p-r-e-p-a-r-a-t-i-o-n.

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-t t-h-e w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e d-u-r-i-n-g p-r-i-v-a-t-e o-f-f-s-i-t-e m-e-e-t-i-n-g s, f-o-r-m-i-n-g a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r f-i-l-e a-s a n-e-x-t, b-u-t o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g t-h-e l-e-g-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w o-f c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n f-a-i-r-n-e-s-s s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d s-i-d-e p-a-y-m-e-n-t s o f f-c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t o-b-li-g-a-t-i-o-n-s t-o c-o-v-e-r t-h-e i-n-i-t-i-a-l s-t-r-a-t-e-g-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g v-a-g-u-e w-e-b-c-h-a-n-g e-n-t-r-y s o-f s-t-r-i-c-t u-n-d-e-r t-a-b-l-e d-e-v-e-l-o-p-m-e-n-t f-e-e-s, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-f p-r-i-v-a-t-e a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t-s t-o t-h-e p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t b-o-a-r-d.

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d a-l-l b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s t-o t-h-e p-u-b-l-i-c t-e-n-d-e-r p-o-r-t-a-l a-s i-f t-h-e-y w-e-r-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l o-f c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n, a-n-d n-e-v-e-r p-e-r-f-o-r-m-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-s-i-t-e p-r-e-p-u-b-l-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-r-e-e-d-o-m o-f i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k.
